name: Session Report
description: Generate an explorable HTML report of Claude Code session usage — tokens, cache efficiency, subagents, skills, and the most expensive prompts — from local ~/.claude/projects transcripts.
longDescription: Wraps a single skill that turns local `~/.claude/projects` transcripts into a self-contained, explorable HTML report: total tokens, per-project and per-subagent usage, skill invocations, cache efficiency, cache breaks, and the most expensive prompts. A bundled `analyze-sessions.mjs` collects the numbers (default window 7 days, `--since 24h`/`30d`/`all`), a bundled `template.html` renders the sorting and drill-downs, and Claude fills in 3-5 anomaly findings plus optimization suggestions. Everything runs locally; nothing is uploaded.
